name: AthenIQ
subtitle: Courses, progress, credentials
promotionalText: Enroll in a course, study offline, and carry your progress and certificates on your phone.
description:
AthenIQ is the student app for AthenIQ Institute courses. Browse the catalog, read lessons, download them for offline study, and keep your progress in one place.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

· Browse the catalog and open any course that is free to start
· Enroll in a course and read every lesson on the phone
· Download a course for study without a connection
· Follow your progress, credits and completed lessons
· Collect certificates as courses finish, ready to show an employer
· Pay for a priced course by transfer: the app issues a reference, the registrar confirms it, and the course opens

FOR REGISTRARS

Staff accounts sign in and see the payment queue and certificate requests that cannot wait for a desk, so a learner is not blocked while someone is away from a computer.

HOW IT WORKS

Courses are taught by AthenIQ Institute and recorded in the console the school already uses. The app is a client for that record: what you see is what your registrar sees.
whatsNew: First release: the catalog, lessons, offline downloads, progress, certificates, and the registrar's queue.
reviewNotes: AthenIQ is a free companion app for AthenIQ Institute students. Signing in is optional: the catalog, course pages, lesson previews and credential verification work without an account. Sign in with a student account to enroll, download lessons for offline study, follow progress and collect certificates; registrars can sign in to see the payment queue. No purchase is made inside the app - priced courses are paid for on the web by transfer. If you need an account for review, reply to the review message and one will be created for you.
